1) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of less than __1000__ Da and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron.

2) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with a __different__ multivalent cation crosslinker.

3) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyalkylenimine is __a polyalkylenimine selected from the group consisting of polyethylenimine, polypropyleneimine, and polybutylenimine__.

4) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyanion is selected from sodium polyvinyl sulfonate, poly (sodium acrylate), poly(sodium styrene sulfonate), copolymers of sodium acrylate with sodium vinylsulfonate or sodium styrene sulfonate; dextran sulfate, and __other anionic polymers__.

5) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 2, wherein said multivalent cation crosslinker is a complexed zirconium compound selected from the group consisting of zirconium acetate, sodium zirconium lactate, zirconium sulfate, zirconium tetrachloride, zirconium orthosulfate, zirconium oxychloride, zirconium carbonate, zirconium ammonium carbonate, zirconium acetylacetonate, aluminum chloride, aluminum sulfate, aluminum citrate, tin chloride, tin sulfate, iron chloride, iron nitrate, titanium chloride, and titanium sulfate, __wherein the amount of said crosslinker is sufficient to form a stable gel with the polyelectrolyte complex__.

6) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, further comprising monovalent or divalent cations selected from the group consisting of sodium, potassium, magnesium __, calcium, or barium__ ions.

8) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex __nanoparticle has an average particle size of about 100 to 800 nm in diameter__.

12) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle entrapping a multivalent cation __selected from the group consisting of Zr, Cr, Ti, Fe, Al, and combinations thereof__.

20) (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a delayed gelling agent comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyethylenimine of less than 2000 Da and a polyvinyl sulfonate intimately associated with a multivalent metal cation crosslinker, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron; b) a polymer having anionic sites that can be crosslinked with said metal cation crosslinker; and c) a fluid __selected from the group consisting of water, brine, and seawater__.

21) (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1; b) a polymer __that is capable of being crosslinked with a); and c) a fluid selected from the group consisting of water, brine, and seawater__. 

24) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is a polymer or copolymers of acrylate, acrylamide, N,N-dimethylacrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid, or sodium 2-acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonate, or __other suitable polymers__. 

26) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where fluid is __selected from the group consisting of water, brine, or seawater__.
